about_the_game:
Sink your teeth into this jam-packed collection of in-game Heroes, Campaign chapters, and cosmetic rewards to kick off your journey in Stormgate:

  • Amara - Vanguard Hero
    Amara, callsign Dagger Lead, has dedicated her life to hunting down the Infernals who took everything from her. She's laser-focused on the job at hand--killing demons--and she's damn good at what she does.

  • Ryker - Vanguard Hero

    Ryker is unmatched in recon and long range support, and is the Resistance’s go-to operative for delicate missions that require a stealthy approach and surgical precision. A bit of a loner, Ryker is always accompanied by his loyal companions - the twin hounds, Ghost and Shadow.

  • Maloc - Infernal Hero
    Maloc is an Infernal Commander who uses his fiery magic to devastating effect. A loyal and relentless soldier, he began at the bottom of the Infernal ranks and fought his way to the top, earning a fearsome reputation and the title Champion of the Host.

  • Warz - Infernal Hero

    Though he was once a Celestial, Warz now leads the Infernal invasion of Earth, answering only to the Domina, Gorgonna. The immensely powerful Netherblade he wields is often the last thing his enemies see.

  • Auralanna - Celestial Hero
    Auralanna is the Sovereign of the Mythia City-State. She's a champion of truth and knowledge and a fierce defender of those in need. Don't mistake her gentle spirit for weakness.

  • Kastiel - Celestial Hero
    Kastiel is the ruthless and amoral warrior-Regent of Arkhos. Devoted to the pursuit of victory at any cost, Kastiel long ago abandoned his people's traditional reverence of Animus. He now drives the Sovereignty of Arkhos towards a secret, heretical objective - the collection and weaponization of Animus to destroy all enemies.

  • Vanguard Campaign - Chapter 1 Missions
    Follow up the free prologue missions with the start of the Vanguard Campaign. Chapter 1 includes three story-driven campaign missions that can be played solo. In the future, you'll also be able to play these missions cooperatively with friends.
    Bonus: Unlock the Fuzzy Moth pet by completing Vanguard Mission 6 on Brutal difficulty.
    The free Prologue missions are Vanguard 1-3; Chapter 1 includes Vanguard Missions 4-6.

  • Vanguard Campaign - Chapter 2 & 3 Missions
    You'll be all set to explore the entire Vanguard Campaign--our first self-contained story arc in the all-new Stormgate universe.
    This bundle includes all three Chapters, each Chapter containing three story-driven campaign missions that can be played solo.

    Bonus: Unlock the Terror Byte and Bobble B.O.B. pets by completing Missions 9 and 12 (respectively) on brutal difficulty.
    In the future, you'll also be able to play these missions cooperatively with friends.

  • Gold Vanguard Army Accent
    Add a little extra bling to your Vanguard uniforms with this special golden accent.

  • Chicken Supporter Pet
    Welcoming this feisty feathered pal to your base is a great way to show your support for the Frost Giant team!

  • Firestorm Fog of War Shader
    When the Infernal invasion decimated nearly all life on Earth, survivors described it as "a world ablaze." Please note that this fiery cosmetic option provides no tactical benefit to either player.

Please read our FAQ for DLC Refund Policy.

short_description: Stormgate is a next-gen RTS set in a new science fantasy universe. Command mechs to defend the Earth or invade it as one of two other invading alien factions. Explore an ever-evolving campaign, group up for 3P co-op vs. AI, or compete in 1v1.
